services.name: Pavilion Rental
services.desc: The Peggy & Jack Jones Pavilion offers space which can accommodate a large group of people for a Texas-sized picnic. This covered pavilion, located beside our splash park, provides shade from the Texas heat with two large ceiling fans. The various size picnic tables, including two that are ADA accessible, provide ample space for birthday parties, family reunions, church picnics or visiting with friends. Air-conditioned restrooms are located at the pavilion. Reservations are required for birthday parties, reunions, and large groups.
